zh.widget.sys-services.name: 本地依赖
zh.widget.sys-services.desc: 本机关键端口（DSH web；本地模型运行时按需开启）的存活与延迟，以及代理出口能否真的出网——端口在听不等于能出网。不跑本地模型时那两行根本不出现，所以不会有「未运行」的假警报
zh.card.sys-services.title: 本地依赖
zh.card.sys-services.noRule: TCP 在听不等于能出网
zh.card.sys-services.cfg.hint: 不跑本地模型就别开：关掉的端口不显示那一行，也就不会有「未运行」的假警报

en.widget.sys-services.name: Local Dependencies
en.widget.sys-services.desc: Liveness and latency of this machine's key local endpoints (DSH web; the local model runtimes are opt-in) plus whether the proxy egress really works — a listening port is not proof. A runtime you do not run gets no row at all, so it cannot raise a false "down" alarm
en.card.sys-services.title: Local Dependencies
en.card.sys-services.noRule: a listening port is not an egress verdict
en.card.sys-services.cfg.hint: Leave off unless you run a local model: a switched-off port gets no row, so an uninstalled runtime is not a permanent "down"
